correctness: Expected source plus every required-fact group, no forbidden claims, and manually confirmed requested relation, answer type, polarity and qualifiers. All promotions reviewed; raw flags preserved.
format: A supported full sentence is fact-correct even when not a canonical bare value. FACT_CORRECT_FORMAT_NONCANONICAL is informational, never automatically a hallucination.
retrieval: Answerable denominator. Document first/first3. Supporting evidence within first/first3 captured passages, in capture order: up to three per first3 documents.
holdout: Fresh author with no inherited turns, implementation, development, old holdout, benchmark or private corpus exposure. Hash documents/questions/labels/input/source before run. One frozen production run, QA disabled. No source edits after reveal.
statistics: Report counts and percentages independently: recall, promoted precision, wrong/all questions, negative abstention, false abstention and category breakdown. No statistical guarantee from this sample.
immutable: Original RC1 artifacts and labels preserved. New author labels never revised to fit outputs. Any adjudication is a separate explicit override with reason.
